description: One control, one label, one message. Forms advance one decision at a time, and a field is that decision made addressable.

MUST: Compose exactly one control, one label and one message.
Associate the label with its control programmatically, so tapping the label reaches the control.
Announce its error through a live region, so a validation failure reaches assistive technology without a focus move.
Take error ink from destructive on the page surface, and from destructiveText when the message sits on a soft surface.
Carry a pending affordance for asynchronous validation, distinct from disabled.
SHOULD: Say what would fix the error rather than what is wrong: "Enter the six digits we sent" over "Invalid input".
Keep the message slot occupied by hint text when there is no error, so the layout does not jump.
NEVER: Compose two controls. Two decisions are two fields.
Replace the label with a placeholder.
Colour the message without also wording it.
